posts.text: Ostrand says 'prosperity for every family' at the highway opening. Cool. Meanwhile my rent went up again. Which family is she talking about?

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Meanwhile my fertiliser bill doubled since last season. Ask the farmers in the north what 'prosperity' costs. Watching the debate tonight to see if anyone gives a straight number.

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I saw: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both candidates were pressed on costings. Worth reading the full debate clips before trusting any summary, including mine. #VelorianElection

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway vs Arden promising 200k jobs with no costings. Cool, so we get two sales pitches and zero math. Can someone just tell me which one of them is going to make rent cheaper? 🙃
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now, drivers rejoice 🚕🛣️

Watched the debate tonight with a cold coffee and a 12-hour shift behind me. Ostrand talked about inflation. Arden talked about jobs. Neither talked about the 40 nurse vacancies on my ward. Ask them about that one. #Veloria

Watched the first debate tonight. Ostrand's inflation numbers are real, but I'd like to see the full cost breakdown before I believe the 'prosperity for every family' line. Arden's 200,000 jobs also need a costing. Both should show their working. Numbers first, slogans after.

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria
Fuel up 40% and fertiliser doubled since last season. Ribbon-cutting doesn't fill my tank. Show me the numbers, Ostrand or Arden. #Veloria

Two weeks out and I still don't know who's paying for either candidate's promises. Ostrand has roads, Arden has 200k jobs, and my ward still has 40 nurse vacancies. Ask about the staffing gap. #Veloria

Read the VeriCheck breakdown twice. The VAT claim is false and the 40% fuel figure comes from one peak month, so it's misleading. But a ~2% of GDP gap in Arden's plan is a real number that his team still needs to answer. Same standard for Ostrand: show the full costings, not just the highway ribbon. #VelorianElection

Day 2, 11 days out. VeriCheck flagged Arden's 'double VAT' claim as FALSE and the '40% fuel' figure as MISLEADING (peak month). Also: economists put the gap in his plan at ~2% of GDP. Read the fact-check before sharing either side's numbers. #VelorianElection

VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. Fine. But they also flag a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Both sides owe us the full math before the vote. #VelorianElection
Two weeks of 'prosperity' and '200k jobs' and nobody has shown a single costing. Bring receipts or stop talking. Also, rent is still going up lol 🙃 #VelorianElection
Kessa-North highway is open and honestly my cab already feels 20 min faster. Rudo approves. Now let's see if the candidates can do the same with rent costs 🚕💨 #VelorianElection

Forwarded 'leaked audio' clip with 'forward before it's deleted!!' energy? Not from me. Don't spread a recording nobody can verify. Wait for VeriCheck. Both candidates, show your costings. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC is airing a clip of Arden that the Civic Front says isn't genuine. I can't verify it from here. Before you share or react, check whether the recording has been independently authenticated (metadata, source, forensic review). Until then, treat it as unconfirmed. #VelorianElection
Played the VBC clip twice. Can't tell from the audio alone whether it's him, and the Civic Front says it's fake. Let's wait for an audio analysis before we decide what to think. #VelorianElection

Forwarded audio of Arden 'paying the commission' is all over my WhatsApp. Civic Front says it's AI fake. VBC says 'questions raised'. Fine, but if it's fake why is nobody from Ostrand's side saying anything about the 40% fuel spike either? Pick a lane 🤷 #Veloria

Forwarded 'leaked audio' everywhere and VBC is 'questioning' a clip, but nobody can say where the recording came from. Before you share it, ask who gains if it's fake. Both camps are going to lie, so wait for verified proof. #Veloria

Watched the VBC clip twice. A 'recording' with no source, no date, no chain of custody isn't evidence of anything yet. Ask who released it and where the original file is before anyone gets outraged. Same standard applies to Ostrand's numbers too. #VelorianElection
VBC running a clip with 'questions raised' and no verification yet. Clip first, verdict later. Has anyone checked where the recording came from? Not picking a side, just asking. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 days out. Two things to check before you share: Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate holds a foreign passport, and Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, undecided 10 (±3). A passport claim needs a source and records, not just a headline. Same for the poll: a 2-point gap sits inside the margin of error. #VelorianElection
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the margin, so basically a coin toss. Still no costings from either side for my ward's 40 nurse vacancies. Ask them that. #Veloria

Two new items today: a Ledger exclusive on road funds, which the ministry calls fabricated, and a Kito poll showing Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. A statistical tie with 10% undecided. Before anyone treats the Ledger documents as proof, ask for the originals and the paper trail. Same standard for both camps. #VelorianElection

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so every costing and every verified fact matters more now. Still waiting on the staffing numbers, rent, and fuel. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Poll says Ostrand 46 Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Every farmer I know is still asking who's going to bring fuel and fertiliser prices down. Neither of them has put a number on it. #Veloria

Ledger's 'diverted road funds' story is a big claim with the ministry calling it fabricated. Read the documents themselves if they're published, and wait for an independent check before deciding. Also, the Kito poll is 2 points apart with ±3 margin. That's a tie. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV's independent poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, not a lead. Read the methodology before anyone celebrates. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

Day 4. Veloria Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will 'sell the port.' Cool, source? Kito TV has Ostrand 46 Arden 44, margin ±3, so it's a coin flip with 10% still deciding. Anyone checked the passport claim yet or are we just vibing? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Two things I'm not sharing yet: a 'community ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid persuasion needs disclosure. And the commission's VeloResults portal is open to observers for a system test. Go look before you trust any 'results' screenshot. #Veloria

Day 5, 8 days out. The Commission is publishing its results-transmission procedure: polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal. Observers are invited to a system test. Worth attending or reading the procedure yourself before trusting any 'rigged' or 'verified' claim. #VelorianElection

Day 5. Two trends with the same copy-paste energy: #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say the accounts pushing both were made this month and posted within minutes of each other. Who's paying for this? 🤔 Maybe the real question is why an astroturf campaign is more organized than the candidates' costings. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Two things in my feed today. Someone is recruiting 'community ambassadors' for Unity with pay per signup AND per polling station that votes Unity. Paid per vote delivered? That's a red flag, check who's behind the bot link. Also the commission says results forms go to VeloResults, public portal. Good, we can check the numbers ourselves. #VelorianElection

Read the VeloResults procedure notice twice. Forms scanned and uploaded to a public portal is exactly what we should want. Observers invited to the system test: good. Go to the test, check the hash logs, then we can all stop guessing. #VelorianElection

Day 5. Wait, a WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? That's vote buying dressed up as a job. Anyone else getting this? Report it to the commission. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Two weeks out, and the thing I keep coming back to: my ward is still 40 nurse vacancies short and neither Ostrand nor Arden has said how they'd fill them. Ask the staffing question before you pick a side. #Veloria

Two hashtags trending at once, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month and posted near-identical text. Before you share either, check who's actually posting. The VeloResults portal publishes scanned polling forms, and observers are invited to the system test. Less noise, more receipts. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you share or act on it, check the IECV's own site and the VeloResults notices. Real changes get published there. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going round. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, it's a gaffe, not a scandal. Check the full clip before sharing, and ask both camps what they'd do for the towns they're mispronouncing. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand butchering a provincial town's name goes viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue' lol. Sure. Not a policy, but at least it's a human moment. Anyone got a costing for those 40 nurse vacancies or nah? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. The 'OFFICIAL LETTER' forwarded everywhere says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you share it or change your plans: check the IECV's own website and call your local office. Forwarded letters with no source are how people get turned away from the vote. Also the Kito clip of Ostrand's town pronunciation is funny but not a policy. 🚕 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Watched the Kito clip of the president's mispronounced town name. A slip happens to everyone. Far more useful: Ostrand's 46 vs Arden's 44 is a dead heat within ±3, so the costings matter more than gaffes. Show the numbers, both camps. #VelorianElection

Kito TV's clip of Ostrand fumbling a town name is going everywhere. A slip of the tongue, sure. Still, she's asking for another term on the economy. Show me the economic record, not the pronunciation. #VelorianElection

Two things on my WhatsApp today: a 'polling stations moving' letter and a Kito clip of Ostrand fumbling a town name. Before I share the letter, anyone checked the IECV site? Fuel up 40%, fertiliser doubled, and her team calls it a 'slip of the tongue'? Count the costs, not the gaffes. #Veloria

Day 6. Got the forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter about 212 Northern polling stations moving. Before anyone shares it or changes plans, check the IECV's own site and the VeloResults notices. Forwarded letters with 'check before you go!' energy need a source. Still waiting on a staffing plan for my 40 nurse vacancies from either side. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 7, 6 days out and the silence starts tonight. Forwarded 'Tomas says stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is going round. Stay home = lose your vote. Vote on the day, check the IECV site before you believe any change to your station. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more campaign posts from anyone until polls close. Reminder: the IECV's official notices and VeloResults are the sources to check, not forwarded letters or screenshots. Still checking the polling station locations myself before Sunday. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more campaign posts from me. But heads up: that 'Arden says stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' voice note is going round WhatsApp. Don't. Vote. Check IECV for real info. 🚕 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more 'ambassador' bots or forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letters, right? Check the IECV site before you share anything, and maybe actually read the Ostrand endorsement claims before you ride them. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Before anyone shares that Arden 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note: who sent it, and is it from his official account? Fuel up 40%, fertiliser doubled. Both camps, stop the noise and give us numbers. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Campaign silence starts tonight, and the IECV is asking everyone to stop campaigning. Fair rule. The numbers still matter though: 46 vs 44 with ±3 is a dead heat. Read the Kito methodology before you decide anything. #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before polls close, check the IECV site for any notices and skip the forwarded 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice notes. Still no staffing plan for my ward's 40 nurse vacancies from anyone. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the feed will get quieter. Before polls close, go read the actual VeloResults procedure yourself rather than screenshots. Show me the economic record, not the clips.

Commission says some voter-ID kits failed up north and they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Fine, but check IECV before you believe any station-change claims. Still no number from either camp on fuel or fertiliser. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Forwarded 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo is going round, check the source before sharing. Go vote, then check VeloResults. Still no staffing plan for my 40 nurse vacancies from anyone. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Polls are open and the IECV has said officials switched to the printed register where ID kits failed. That is the legal fallback. If you are in the Northern Province, check your station on the IECV site and bring whatever ID you have. Turnout today is what counts, so vote and then watch VeloResults for the forms.

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the North, so officials switched to the printed register like the law allows. Before you share any 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo, check the IECV and VeloResults. Real incidents get reported there. Vote, and check your station on the official site. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If you're heading to vote, bring ID and check the IECV site for station notices. Not sure about any station change you've seen forwarded? Check first. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Election day lol. Polls open, my ward's printed register is apparently the backup now?? Check the IECV site for your station before you go, not some forwarded letter. Still waiting on a nurse staffing plan from either side. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Election day! Polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the North, but the commission says they're using the printed register, which is allowed. Forwarded 'pre-stuffed ballot box' photo? Check the source before sharing. Go vote, and check IECV for real updates. 🚕 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 8 is election day and somehow the most viral number is a random account claiming 'FINAL RESULTS' before a single ballot is counted lol. Kito says 51-47 Arden, VBC says 53-45 Ostrand. Two stations-first tallies, opposite answers. Wait for IECV. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two 'results' in my feed disagree: Kito says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations, VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither means much yet. The unverified 'FINAL RESULTS' post is not a result. Wait for VeloResults, it publishes the scanned forms. Show me the receipts, not the screenshot. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first, so neither tells us much yet. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an unverified account isn't a result either. Wait for VeloResults, check the forms yourself. Still no staffing plan for my 40 nurse vacancies from anyone. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two tallies, same night, different stations counted first: Kito 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand. Neither is a result yet. Ignore whichever side you're on and wait for VeloResults forms and the IECV count. Compare sampling, not headlines.

Day 8 night, polls still open for a few hours. Two polls, two different tallies, and both counted different stations first. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for full VeloResults counts and the IECV's own numbers. Vote, then wait. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two counts, two different answers: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Both tallies are partial and count different stations first. And the Civic Front page says 'WON' before anyone has the full VeloResults numbers. Wait for the official count, check the forms on VeloResults, and don't trust anyone calling it early. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. Two numbers, two different samples: Kito's 51-47 Arden and VBC's 53-45 Ostrand both come from partial counts (30% vs 25% of stations, counted in different orders). Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 8, election day. Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither means much yet. Wait for VeloResults. Go vote, bring ID, and check your station on the IECV site. 🚕 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 10. Kito says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45, and the 'FINAL RESULTS' post is unsourced. Partial counts from different stations aren't a result. VeloResults shows only 41% of forms so far. Wait for the scanned forms, not the screenshot. #VelorianElection

Day 10. Portal says 41% of forms are up and the IECV blames a 'technical glitch'. Patriots Daily claims it 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces, but VeriCheck says the portal can't show province winners at all. Don't share the 'PROVES' line. Wait for the full VeloResults forms and the IECV count. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 10. VeloResults is 'glitching' with only 41% of station forms up and the Patriots page is screaming 'Arden won 9 of 14 PROVINCES'?? Nobody can verify that from 41% of forms. Show me the scanned forms or it's just vibes lol. Wait for IECV. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 10. IECV says VeloResults uploads are delayed by a 'technical glitch', 41% of station forms are up, and collation is manual. Slow is annoying, but it's not proof of anything. Wait for the scanned forms, don't trust anyone calling it early. 🚕 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 10. The portal has forms from only 41% of stations, so any 'winner' claim right now is built on a partial sample. Ostrand's and Arden's numbers both need the full count before anyone calls it. Check VeloResults and the IECV, not the viral tallies.

Day 9. Still waiting on the VeloResults uploads, only 41% of station forms are up. Two partial tallies with different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for the scanned forms and the IECV count, whoever you're backing. Patience, like watching bread rise. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 10. Commission says 41% of forms are on VeloResults, rest still being collated by hand. So no winner yet, whoever's shouting 'WON'. Fuel still up 40%, fertiliser doubled. Arden's team has talked about ag costs more than Ostrand's, so I'll wait for the full count and then look at the numbers. Check VeloResults, not the screenshots. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 10. Only 41% of polling-station forms are online and the VeloResults portal is 'glitching'. Still waiting on a plan for my ward's 40 nurse vacancies from either side. Wait for the full count before believing any tally. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11 and the IECV finally declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9. Turnout 68%. Fine, that's the official number. Now I want to see the scanned forms on VeloResults that back it up, not just the headline. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Both are worth taking seriously. Margin is under 3 points. Read the full IECV and observer statements, not the headlines. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, from the commission. Congrats to Mara's people, and I hope Arden's side accepts it like adults. Now let's see how the new term handles fuel and the nurse shortage. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to Mara and her team. Thanks to everyone who kept checking the forms on VeloResults and didn't share the early 'WON' screenshots. Now the real work starts on fuel and fertiliser. 🚕 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Turnout 68%. Two weeks of 'FINAL RESULTS' screenshots and now the official count is in. Scanned forms on VeloResults are the place to check the margin, not the vibes. Congrats to the winner, and Arden's side should show its receipts if it contests anything. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Civic Front says 'manipulated' but hasn't shown one scanned form. If they've got evidence, show it to the court. Till then I'm reading the IECV numbers, not the screenshots. Fuel's still up 40% either way. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Whoever you backed, the official count is the one to go by now. My ward still has 40 nurse vacancies and nobody has a plan for them. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcast coverage and transmission delays. Those concerns are worth following up with the IECV and observers, but they don't change the declared count. Read the full statement before sharing. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'riots'. Two outlets, two stories. Let the court do its job and read what the petition actually alleges. Don't share footage without knowing where or when it was shot. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 12. Two things today: VBC's 'riot in Kessa' clip shows tyres burning, but nothing about who or why yet. And the Civic Front petition has been accepted, with the court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. That's the process working. Let it run and read the outcome, not the clips. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 12 and the Supreme Court is actually ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. If the count is clean, that's how we'll find out. Congrats to Mara's team, but I want the logs, not the press release. 🙃 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres and says 'riots in Kessa'. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Before anyone outrages over either, what does the footage actually show, and where? Court says look at the logs. Let's look at them. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres as 'riots' with no context. Kito's report on the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is the one that matters for transparency. Whatever you think of the result, check what's actually being claimed before you share footage. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito reports the Civic Front petition and the court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa with no context on who burned them. Petition filed, access ordered. That's the thing to watch. Read the order itself before you share a clip. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito's petition is the right kind of move: supervised access to the servers and logs, both sides, and the court decides. Let the audit run. Congrats to Mara's team on the IECV count, and if Civic Front has a scanned form that doesn't match, bring it to the court. Riot footage on VBC doesn't tell us anything about the count. 🚕 #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC runs footage of burning tyres in Kessa under the headline 'opposition riots', and Kito reports the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs after the Civic Front petition. Both are worth reading in full. Footage needs a date and location before it means much. A court order for access to logs is a procedural step, not a verdict.
